map.按机型巡航耗油率与飞行距离/时间估算航段燃油消耗，含滑行、备份油量: Estimate sector fuel burn from the cruise fuel flow of the type and the flight distance/time, including taxi and reserve fuel.
map.= 巡航耗油率 × 飞行时间 × 航段系数: = cruise fuel flow × flight time × sector factor
map.= 巡航耗油率 × (备份时间/60)，按规章不少于 30-45 分钟: = cruise fuel flow × (reserve time/60), by regulation no less than 30-45 minutes
map.= 滑行油 + 航段油 + 备份油: = taxi fuel + sector fuel + reserve fuel
map.飞行时间 t = 距离 / 巡航速度；航段油 = 耗油率 × t × 航段系数；: Flight time t = distance / cruise speed; sector fuel = fuel flow × t × sector factor; reserve fuel = fuel flow × reserve minutes / 60; total fuel = taxi fuel + sector fuel + reserve fuel; volume = total fuel / 0.8 (kg/L)
Estimate sector fuel from the cruise fuel flow and flight time, then add taxi and reserve fuel for the block total; jet fuel density is about 0.8 kg/L, used for the volume conversion.
map.注：实际耗油受载重、航路风向、巡航高度、温度等影响，本工具为估算参考，不可直接用: Note: actual fuel burn is affected by payload, en-route wind, cruise altitude and temperature; this tool is an estimation reference and must not be used directly for flight planning.
map.按机型典型油耗率与飞行距离/时间，估算航段燃油消耗。: Estimate sector fuel burn from typical type-specific fuel flow and the flight distance/time.
map.对比不同机型（窄体/宽体）单位周转量油耗，做选型或排班。: Compare the fuel burn per unit of traffic between types (narrow-body/wide-body) for fleet selection or scheduling.
map.已知油箱容量与油耗，反推最大航程或备降裕度。: Given tank capacity and fuel flow, back-calculate the maximum range or diversion margin.
map.A320 巡航油耗约 2.5 t/h、巡航速度约 830 km/h。飞行距离 1: The A320 cruises at about 2.5 t/h and about 830 km/h. For a flight distance of 1200 km: time≈1.45 h then fuel≈2.5×1.45≈3.6 t (excluding taxi/diversion/reserve fuel).
map.为什么实际加油比估算多很多？: Why is the actual uplift much more than the estimate?
map.估算只是巡航油耗，实际还需起飞爬升增量油、航路备降油、等待油、公司备份油与滑行油: The estimate is only cruise fuel; in reality you also need takeoff/climb increment fuel, en-route diversion fuel, holding fuel, company reserve fuel and taxi fuel, which together are often 1.3-1.6 times the cruise value. This tool gives the sector base fuel burn.
map.机型油耗率从哪来？: Where does the type fuel flow come from?
map.来自飞机制造商性能手册或航司运行数据，随载重、高度、温度、风显著变化。本工具用典: From aircraft manufacturer performance manuals or airline operational data, varying significantly with payload, altitude, temperature and wind. This tool uses typical values for illustration; for precise loading rely on the flight planning system.
